policies.name: Commercial General Liability
policies.description: Comprehensive coverage for third-party bodily injury and property damage.
policies.fullDescription: This policy provides coverage for bodily injury and property damage to third parties, including premises, operations, products, and completed operations. It also includes personal and advertising injury coverage.
keyFeatures: Broad coverage for general liability exposures.
Coverage for damage to rented premises.
Medical expense coverage for third-party injuries.

covered: A customer slips and falls on your property, sustaining an injury.
Your completed roofing project causes water damage to a client's interior.
An employee accidentally damages a client's property while working.
A claim of libel or slander arises from your advertising.
notCovered: Damage to your own tools or equipment.
Injuries to your employees (covered by Workers' Compensation).
Losses due to certified acts of terrorism (declined).
Damage caused by specific excluded roofing operations (e.g., Hot Tar).

policies.name: Commercial Excess Liability Policy
policies.description: Additional layer of liability protection over underlying policies.
policies.fullDescription: This policy provides an additional layer of liability coverage above the limits of your underlying Commercial General Liability policy, offering broader protection against catastrophic claims.
keyFeatures: Provides an additional $1,000,000 in liability coverage.
Covers claims exceeding underlying General Liability limits.
Defense costs are in addition to the limit of liability.
Protects against large, unforeseen liability judgments.

covered: A major accident exhausts your underlying General Liability limits, and this policy covers the excess.
A large lawsuit for bodily injury exceeds $1,000,000, and this policy pays the amount above the underlying GL.
Defense costs for a covered claim that are in addition to the policy limit.
notCovered: Claims that are not covered by the underlying General Liability policy.
Losses below the underlying General Liability policy's limits.
Claims arising from excluded activities or perils in the underlying policy.

considerations: A $500 deductible applies per claim for General Liability.
Minimum earned premium applies (25% for GL, 25% or $250 for Excess).
Policies are subject to audit, which may adjust final premium.
Specific roofing operations (e.g., Hot Tar, Torch Down) are excluded.
Terrorism coverage is declined for both policies.
Subcontractors must maintain their own GL with equal/greater limits and provide COI.
coverageStrengths: High General Aggregate and Each Occurrence limits for primary liability.
Includes Products/Completed Operations coverage for completed work.
Personal and Advertising Injury protection for non-physical harms.
Additional layer of Excess Liability provides broader protection against catastrophic claims.
Medical Expense Limit for third-party injuries on premises.
